hlg.name: Register and Configure New Hospital Entities
hlg.description: Register and configure a new hospital entity in the system, including metadata registration and hospital-specific operational settings configuration.

branches.hlg_prime: Register and configure a new hospital entity in the system, including metadata registration and hospital-specific operational settings configuration.

hlg.name: Improve Operational Visibility
hlg.description: Enable hospital managers to monitor real-time data and performance metrics to support decision-making.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable Hospital Manager to monitor real-time operational performance and export historical operational data for analysis and compliance.

hlg.name: Enhance Patient Care Coordination
hlg.description: Support healthcare staff in managing patient appointments, medical records, and check-in processes efficiently.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.

hlg.name: Enable Patient Self-Service
hlg.description: Allow patients to search for hospitals and receive location-based recommendations to improve access to care.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability

hlg.name: Support Clinical Documentation
hlg.description: Enable hospital staff to register patients, maintain medical notes, and manage check-in information for accurate treatment records.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.

hlg.name: Optimize Resource Management
hlg.description: Allow logistics staff to manage inventory, blood samples, and product requests to ensure clinical and logistical efficiency.

branches.hlg_prime: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking, and product approval decisions.
